title: 'Environmental Constraints'
subtitle: 'Parcel ' || "parcel_id" || ' | SYNTHETIC DESKTOP SCREENING'
wetland_summary: 'Wetland indicator: ' || CASE WHEN "wetland_status" = 'intersects' THEN 'mapped overlap' WHEN "wetland_status" = 'no_mapped_intersection' THEN 'no mapped intersection (covered area)' WHEN "wetland_status" = 'partial_source_coverage' THEN 'PARTIAL COVERAGE - remainder unknown' ELSE 'NO SOURCE COVERAGE - unknown' END || ' | known overlap ' || format_number("wetland_known_pct", 1) || '% | coverage ' || format_number("wetland_coverage_pct", 1) || '%'
flood_summary: 'Flood indicator: ' || CASE WHEN "flood_status" = 'intersects' THEN 'mapped overlap' WHEN "flood_status" = 'no_mapped_intersection' THEN 'no mapped intersection (covered area)' WHEN "flood_status" = 'partial_source_coverage' THEN 'PARTIAL COVERAGE - remainder unknown' ELSE 'NO SOURCE COVERAGE - unknown' END || ' | known overlap ' || format_number("flood_known_pct", 1) || '% | coverage ' || format_number("flood_coverage_pct", 1) || '%'
